summary: Hard cut in at 2.700s (30fps frame all_0082) from the gold "A" belt-buckle close-up. Hard cut out after frame all_0116 (3.833s), to the horse shot at 3.867s. This is a frontal, near-static medium shot on a sunny wide beach. The man (center, foreground) holds silver sunglasses horizontally in front of his chest and lip-syncs "THE AURA FARMER" straight into the lens. Two women stand ~4 studs behind him and ~4 studs to each side, forming a triangle with him at the front point. At the start they wear red sunglasses. Between 2.77s and 3.07s each grips her glasses at the temples, pulls them down past her face and makes an awed open-mouth "O". She then holds the glasses horizontally at waist or lower-chest height for the rest of the shot. The right woman leads the pull by about 1 frame. The glasses-down move centers on the off-beat at 2.846s and lands in the hold on beat 3.090s. The man's lip-sync goes: "THE" at 2.70, "AU" (huge open mouth, eyes squeezed) at 2.80-3.00, "ra" at 3.03-3.17, a pursed-lip "F" frown at 3.23-3.30, "AR" at 3.37-3.50, "M" lips together at 3.567 (on beat 3.578) and "ER" from 3.60 to 3.83. Over the last 0.25s he leans toward the lens. A static yellow-to-orange italic subtitle "THE AURA FARMER" stays on screen for the whole shot.

camera.framing: Medium shot (waist-up) of the man, centered. The frame top cuts ~0.3 studs above his hair (hair top at ~9% from frame top). The frame bottom cuts across his hips/belt line. His head spans y=9%..43% of frame height (head incl. hair ~1/3 of the frame height). His elbows nearly reach x=29% and x=69% of frame width. The left woman is at x~16% of frame width, visible from head (top at y~32%) to mid-thigh, which is cut by the frame bottom. The right woman is at x~85%, visible from head (top at y~27%) to upper thighs. The horizon/boulevard line sits at y~40% of frame (190/480 px) and crosses the man's chin and the women's eyes. Sky fills the top ~38% of the frame and sand the bottom 60%. Aspect ratio 16:9.
camera.position: Camera on the subjects' front axis, square to the man. Distance from the man's face ~3.8 studs (about 0.7 man-heights; real world ~1.25 m). Distance to the two women ~7.8 studs (they appear at half the man's head size). Camera height ~4.75 studs above the sand, which is the man's chin height: the horizon crosses his chin. Horizontal angle 0 deg: dead-on frontal, no yaw offset. Suggested Roblox placement: camera at (0, 4.75, 0) looking at (0, 4.4, -3.8). Man's root at (0, 0, -3.8). Left woman at (-4.2, 0, -7.8). Right woman at (+4.3, 0, -7.8).
camera.angle: Pitch about -5 deg (looking slightly down: the horizon sits about 50 px above frame center). Yaw 0. Roll 0 (horizon level; the buildings' verticals are straight). Not a low or high angle in feel: it is eye-level with the man's chin.
camera.lensNotes: Moderately wide lens, ~24-28 mm full-frame equivalent (vertical FOV ~46-50 deg). The camera is close to the man, so his head and hands look slightly enlarged relative to the women behind him (mild near-field wide-angle exaggeration). Straight lines show no visible barrel distortion. Depth of field is deep, like a phone or small sensor: the man, the women and the far buildings are all acceptably sharp, with no background blur, no bokeh and no focus pull. There is slight video-compression softness and mild sharpening.

movement.description: Cut in. The camera is effectively locked off (gimbal/steady handheld). Framing as described.

A very slow push-in begins. The background expands outward from center by ~1 px per 0.1 s: the right-side buildings drift right and the left sand drifts left. This is equivalent to ~0.5% scale by 3.0s.
Push-in reaches ~1% scale (background edges moved ~2 px outward on an 854 px frame). There is a tiny horizontal drift of ~1 px toward frame-right (camera yaw <0.1 deg left).

Push-in ends at ~1.5% total scale (an FOV change of 48 -> ~47.3 deg, or a 0.06-stud dolly forward). Over the last 0.25 s the man also leans toward the lens, so he grows ~4% in frame (head top rises from y=47 px to y=40 px). Cut at 3.867s.

camera.shake: Minimal. Sub-pixel to 1 px micro-drift, with no visible handheld jitter, no whip pans and no zoom snaps. In Roblox, add only a very subtle Perlin noise: rotation amplitude ~0.05 deg at ~1-1.5 Hz, translation <0.01 studs.

subjects.motionNotes: The body stays almost stationary. Most of the life is in the lip-sync, eyes and brows, with a slow lean in at the end (3.63-3.83) that builds energy into the cut. Head nods follow the vowel shapes: the chin lifts on big open vowels ('AU' 2.83-2.97) and tucks on the closed 'F' (3.23). The biggest mouth opening falls on the off-beat at 2.846-2.9. The 'M' closure lands on beat 3.578. The hands fidget the glasses ~8 deg in roll around 3.1 and return to level by 3.47. There is no bounce in the knees. Use smooth ease-in-out on the head, with no overshoot.

subjects.motionNotes: She starts the pull ~1-2 frames before the left woman (2.767 vs 2.833). Her movement reads bigger because her elbows begin high and wide and sweep down and in, a 'wing-closing' arc. The descent runs ~2.77 -> 3.03 with ease-in-out, fastest around 2.87-2.93, and settles with a tiny overshoot on beat 3.090. After that she stays nearly frozen (holding the glasses like a bar) with only mouth and head-tilt changes. There is no bounce.

set: A wide, flat, dry sandy beach on a sunny day (a North-Sea city-beach look, like Scheveningen). The sea is not visible; it would be behind the camera. Ground: flat tan sand (#B5A18B where lit in the midground, #A89685 far, #7E6E5B for the nearer slightly shaded sand at the frame bottom). On the left half, long parallel tractor/tire ruts (darker grooves #6E604F, ~0.3 studs wide, in pairs ~1 stud apart) run diagonally from the bottom-left foreground toward the center-right distance. On the right half the sand is churned with many footprints and lumps, each with a small dark shadow (#5A4C3E) on its far side, about 0.5-1 stud scale. Background along the horizon (all at real-world 100-400 m, Roblox ~300-1200 studs): far left, a few tiny distant people (silhouettes ~0.1 of frame height or smaller) and a lamppost/flagpole with a small round sign. Left-center (x 20-32% of frame): a large white beach pavilion with a wavy, tent-like scalloped white roof (#E8E8EC), ~60x12 studs, at ~500 studs. Center: a long low row of beach-club pavilions with turquoise/blue awnings and parasols (#3F7C96, #2E6A88) and white walls, spanning x 33-75% of frame, plus a tall thin white flagpole/antenna directly behind the man's left shoulder (x~41%). A small group of people sits on the sand in the midground just left of the man (x~38%, y~43%; ~40 studs away), and a lone person stands behind the man's right side (x~54%). Right (x 70-100% of frame): a skyline of mid-rise seafront buildings at ~700-900 studs. A dark teal-green glass tower (#2E5A5E, ~8 floors, ~110 studs tall), a white slab building (#D8D8D4) beside it, then beige/gray 10-12 floor apartment blocks with horizontal balcony bands (#8E8C80 and #B4AE9E) at ~120-130 studs tall, plus a few low white/gray buildings at their base. Sky: clear blue, deep at the top (#4F7D9C) fading lighter toward the horizon (#8FA6B8, slightly hazy). Thin wispy cirrus streaks run diagonally from the upper-left toward the center at ~25% height, plus a faint streak at the upper right. No sun in frame.
lighting: Bright, clear-sky midday or early-afternoon sunlight. Key: hard direct sun from behind the camera and to camera-right (sun azimuth ~30-40 deg right of the camera's view axis, behind the camera), elevation ~45-50 deg. It front-lights all three subjects with crisp shadows. The man's screen-right side (his left cheek and left arm) is brightly lit (#DFCDCC); his screen-left forearm and the side of his nose fall into shade (#3A2A26 to #8A5E52). The underside of his chin and his eye sockets get soft shadow from the high sun. The white tank tops are near clipping (#E6E4EA) with soft gray-violet shading in the folds (#C0B7C0). Fill: strong blue sky ambient plus bounce from the bright sand (warm), so shadows are open, not black, with a slightly cool cast. There is no distinct rim light. Color temperature is daylight ~5600K. Skin reads warm/pinkish and the sky slightly teal-blue (graded), with the sand a neutral-warm tan. Exposure is bright, with highlights on whites and skin near the top of the range. Contrast is medium-high and the blacks are crushed (the black pants and shorts read #05080E with no detail). Saturation is moderate and slightly muted/filmic; the only strong saturated accents are the red sunglasses (#E0182A) and the subtitle. No lens flare and no visible bloom beyond a slight glow on the white tank tops.

effects.description: Hard cut in from the previous shot (gold 'A' belt-buckle close-up on a purple suit, subtitle 'DO DO DO...'). No transition, flash or blur. The subtitle switches to 'THE AURA FARMER' on the same frame.
The subtitle overlay 'THE AURA FARMER' is visible for the whole shot, fully static (no pop, scale or shake).
A subtle digital/optical push-in starts (~1.5% scale by 3.83). It is almost imperceptible and optional.
Hard cut out to the next shot (cartoon horse in a purple suit and sunglasses, subtitle back to 'DO DO DO DO DO DO DO DO DO').

subtitle: "THE AURA FARMER" is shown for the whole shot, from 2.700s (first frame) to 3.833s (last frame). It disappears at the cut at 3.867s, when the next shot's subtitle 'DO DO DO DO DO DO DO DO DO' appears. Style: all caps in a heavy condensed italic sans, similar to Impact Italic or 'Bangers'. Fill is a vertical gradient from bright yellow (#FFE23A) at the top through orange (#FFA010) to orange-red (#FF5A00) at the bottom. A dark crimson (#9A0F12) 3D extrusion / drop shadow sits offset ~2 px right and ~3 px down (on a 480p frame), with a thin dark-red outline. Placement: bottom center, horizontally centered at ~50.5% of frame width, spanning ~30% of the frame width (x 35.5%-66%). Cap height ~4.6% of frame height; baseline at ~94% of frame height (cap tops at ~89.5%). It overlaps the man's lower tank top. There is no background box.
recreateInRoblox: WORLD: Use a large flat Terrain or Part floor with Material=Sand, Color #B5A18B. Add a slight darker variation near the camera (#8A7A66) using a second large Part or Terrain paint. Make tire ruts from long thin Parts (0.3 x 0.05 x 60 studs, Sand, Color #6E604F), sunk slightly, in pairs 1 stud apart, rotated ~25 deg so they run from the lower-left foreground toward the center-right distance.
